docs.purpose: Powers the main admin dashboard's overview numbers — how many permits, builders, and committee-of-adjustment applications exist, how many are linked to properties, neighbourhoods and contractor-registry records, and how fresh and healthy each data pipeline currently is — so an admin can see overall system health at a glance.
docs.data_story: It reads 20 tables — `permits`, `entities`, `trades`, `trade_mapping_rules`, `sync_runs`, `notifications`, `permit_parcels`, `coa_applications`, `permit_trades`, `address_points`, `parcels`, `building_footprints`, `parcel_buildings`, `neighbourhoods`, `wsib_registry`, `lead_views`, `pipeline_runs`, `pipeline_schedules`, `information_schema.columns` and `pg_class` and writes `pipeline_runs`. Its response is an explicit pick-by-name projection of 38 fields, so a column added to a table upstream does not leak into the client by accident. It is called from 2 places: `web_dashboard`, `admin_data_quality`.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `QUERY`. It declares its `database.reads[]` with named columns, its response projection as an explicit whitelist, its auth class, its rate bucket and its staleness — and `outputs.writes` is forced to `"none"`. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.

notes: GET-only, but EVERY call invokes reapStaleRunningRows() (src/lib/admin/reap-stale-runs.ts), which UPDATEs pipeline_runs to auto-fail rows stale by their heartbeat (or 2h wall clock) — so this nominally read-only stats endpoint has a real, unaudited side-effect write on every poll. information_schema.columns and pg_class are Postgres catalogs, not application tables. No verifyAdminAuth import. Its pipeline-freshness / chain-alias block duplicates pipelines/status/route.ts almost verbatim. Thirty-plus COUNT queries run in parallel, most wrapped in .catch(() => 0) so a missing table degrades a metric rather than failing the response. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: FINDINGS. (1) MISSING GUARD — the most exposed of my six: no verifyAdminAuth (imports :1-7), yet this route fans out ~38 queries across ~20 tables AND performs a WRITE (the reaper at :189). src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:9-11 mandates the call; only the presence-only middleware check (src/middleware.ts:115) stands in front of it. (2) The task brief's premise about the 7 engine_health_* logic variables is WRONG FOR THIS ROUTE: /api/admin/stats reads no logic variables at all (whole-file read; no logic_variables SQL, no resolver import). They are read by src/app/api/quality/route.ts (header :37-38, application :211-212), with names/defaults in src/lib/quality/types.ts:492-515. Their Zod bounds and on_invalid posture are UNRESEARCHED — see engine_health_logic_variables.bounds/on_invalid — because /api/quality is not one of my routes. (3) A WRITE HIDES INSIDE A 'QUERY' ROUTE: reapStaleRunningRows() at :189 UPDATEs pipeline_runs to status='failed' (src/lib/admin/reap-stale-runs.ts:26-28). Its only call site in src/ is this GET, so stale-run reaping happens only when a human loads the admin dashboard; and its failure is swallowed by an empty catch (src/lib/admin/reap-stale-runs.ts:38-40). (4) UNPARAMETERISED SQL INTERPOLATION at :102: `linked_confidence < ${COA_IDENTITY_LINK_MIN_CONFIDENCE}` splices a TS module constant (src/lib/coa/link-confidence.ts:17, value 0.85) straight into the SQL string. Not injectable today (compile-time numeric constant, no request input on this route), but it is the one string-built predicate here. (5) SILENT-DEGRADATION CLASS: 15 `.catch(() => [{count:'0'}])` swallows (:123-186) plus 6 block-level empty catches (:222, :280, :350, :367, :387, :406) mean a broken table renders as a plausible zero with no error signal, no logError, and no flag in the payload. Note the asymmetry — the first ~17 queries (:52-119) have NO .catch, so those failures 500 the whole route. (6) KNOWN GAP, COMMENT vs CODE: the comment block at :296-301 says the 3-status IN-list misses run-chain.js's 4th status 'deferred_to_full'. The CODE is at :317 — `status IN ('completed','completed_with_warnings','completed_with_errors')` — and indeed omits it, so a deferred chain reads as never-completed and therefore stale (:342-344). The comment's claim matches the code, but the comment is not the evidence; :317 is. (7) ENVELOPE DEVIATION: bare 38-key object at :413-461, bare {error} at :464-467 (see envelope.deviations). (8) NO SELECT * on this route. (9) CENSUS AGREES COMPLETELY: all 20 census_reads tables confirmed at the lines above, and census_writes [pipeline_runs] confirmed at :189 -> src/lib/admin/reap-stale-runs.ts:26.
